scope_verdict: M184 is a credible executable module-only K8 fixed-bank frontend and a materially better frontend Pareto point than M180. Under identical 28nm, 3ns, max-fanout16, ideal-clock and ZeroWireload synthesis conditions, removing the global top-four ranking and bank-to-lane packing reduces total cell area by 30.455833%, combinational area by 42.305743%, cell count by 33.968211% and logic levels from 161 to 136 while the bounded exact-payload analytic schedule is 1.307080x faster than K4. The resulting 1.879496x same-clock conditional schedule-throughput per frontend logic area is valid only as a matched analytic-plus-DC screen, not as physical, complete-FC2, system or headline speedup.

independent_edge_vcs.missing_review_coverpoint: same-cycle header rearm was already covered once in the primary exact run

m182_interface_audit.descriptor_definition: ordered nonzero 96-bit beats with absolute 5-bit beat indices
m182_interface_audit.window_partition: accepted nonzero descriptor order with D={2,4,8,8}
m182_interface_audit.group_definition: one earliest remaining source from each nonempty modulo-8 bank, so groups per window equal maximum bank population
m182_interface_audit.replay_definition: each source group is held for output_blocks={1,2,4,8} accepted results
m182_interface_audit.dual_window_definition: one descriptor fill and one group-result drain can overlap, with buffer reuse only after the prior drain
m182_interface_audit.cycle_boundary_finding: For nonzero tokens the M182 recurrence equals first descriptor_accept to token_done_valid. The physical token_done_accept is one later edge with ready asserted. A zero token's value 2 equals header_accept to token_done_accept. Therefore the 97,607,807 figure is not a header-to-header module throughput count.

verified_matched_dc.qualification: All five report_constraint classes pass and the run meets the predeclared bounds. Setup and hold have essentially zero engineering margin, and the ideal-clock/ZeroWireload run leaves a 1924-load tie-high net as TIM-134 information; this is not CTS, routed timing or paper PPA.

matched_m180_comparison.capacity_relation: Both frontends contain two D8-capable bitmap windows; M180 emits four ranked/prefix-packed sources plus bank IDs, whereas M184 emits an arbitrary mask and up to eight structural bank slots.
matched_m180_comparison.verdict: The removal of global top-four sorting and bank-to-lane packing is materially reflected in mapped combinational area and logic-level reduction. The critical path remains group_ready-to-selected-channel and has almost no slack, so the implementation simplification is real but not yet a robust physical timing result.

composition_gap.m184_output: arbitrary group_bank_valid mask, structural slot equals bank, no bank IDs
composition_gap.m183_input: prefix-packed issue_slot_valid with explicit issue_bank_id and uniqueness checking
composition_gap.finding: The current M183 arithmetic cannot consume M184 directly. Adding a compactor and bank-ID payload would restore part of the logic deliberately removed by M184.
composition_gap.required_action: Implement a true fixed-bank K8 accumulator/weight-response interface that accepts the arbitrary mask structurally, then synthesize and simulate the composed path.

P0.finding: M184's arbitrary fixed-bank output is incompatible with the existing M183 prefix-packed bank-ID input.
P0.required_action: Build and verify a structural fixed-bank K8 accumulator or include and cost a compaction adapter. Do not claim complete FC2 until weight response, accumulator context and numeric equivalence are composed.

P0.finding: The 97,607,807 cycles and 1.307080x/4.344534x ratios are exact-payload analytic schedule values. M184 VCS proves controller behavior on directed/review traffic, not all 120 payloads, and DC contributes logic cost rather than measured cycle speed.
P0.required_action: Keep 1.879496x as a conditional same-clock schedule-throughput per frontend logic-area screen. Forbid physical, complete-FC2, system and headline wording until native producer, weight banks, arithmetic and representative exact-payload replay are included.

P1.finding: Setup slack is +0.0023 ns and hold slack is 0.0000 ns under ideal clock and ZeroWireload; the critical path still begins at group_ready.
P1.required_action: Register or pipeline the ready-to-selector/load boundary and rerun matched DC/PT with nonzero precommitted margin before treating 3ns as physically robust.

P1.finding: The primary test has one-descriptor partial windows but no nonzero multi-window partial-final token. The review-only regression proves 29 partial-final windows across all stages.
P1.required_action: Promote stage0/1/2/3 multi-window partial-final cases and an explicit partial-close cover into the exact-SHA primary regression.

P1.finding: The RTL implements 4/8/16/32 header and descriptor extent checks, but the primary exact run attacks only the stage0 header bound. The review-only test passes all four header bounds and three explicit descriptor bounds.
P1.required_action: Move all-stage header and descriptor extent attacks into the sealed regression.

P1.finding: The recurrence is structurally consistent and matches four review partial cases, but its nonzero interval ends at done-valid rather than done-accept and no 120-payload RTL replay exists.
P1.required_action: Document the precise cycle interval and replay a frozen representative set or materialized all-payload group stream through RTL before equating 97,607,807 with executable module throughput.

P1.finding: M184 exposes eight simultaneous structural sources but excludes eight SRAM reads, response stalls, address routing and the 96-bit channel payload's physical wiring.
P1.required_action: Compose an eight-bank weight-response shell and backpressure it into group_ready; report macro/banking area and stalled cycles.

P2.finding: Scoreboards prove earliest-event and conservation behavior, but bound SVA does not directly assert window event conservation, buffer ownership or partial-final closure.
P2.required_action: Add ghost counters/ownership assertions or a formal-friendly invariant layer.

P2.finding: DC reports five VER-318 signed-to-unsigned index/conversion warnings and a 1924-load tie-high TIM-134 net.
P2.required_action: Use explicit unsigned casts/widths and disclose tie-cell/CTS cleanup; say five constraint classes clean rather than every physical net fanout-clean.

P2.finding: The precommit contracts intentionally retain false postrun admission fields while RUN_COMPLETE records the pass.
P2.required_action: If a single machine-readable admission is needed, add a non-destructive overlay keyed to both RUN_COMPLETE hashes.
